title: Recording: Give Me Something, I’m Moving On, Kiss Kiss Kiss, Watching The Wheels by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

An overdub session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 20 September 1980.

It began with Ono recording lead vocals for ‘Give Me Something’ and ‘I’m Moving On’, followed by the vocal expressions in the coda of ‘Kiss Kiss Kiss’. Afterwards, Lennon recorded his vocals for ‘Watching The Wheels’.

Page last updated: 18 May 2026
